records_one_merge_entry_per_lane.name: records_one_merge_entry_per_lane
records_one_merge_entry_per_lane.where: kind = 'merge_entry' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND json_extract(data, '$.occupies') IS NOT NULL

records_session_reference_fallback_idx.name: records_session_reference_fallback_idx
columns:
(CASE WHEN json_valid("data") THEN (
    json_extract("data", '$.servingAgentId') GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*'
    OR json_extract("data", '$.servingAgent') GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*'
    OR json_extract("data", '$.ranAs[0].agentId') GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*'
    OR json_array_length("data", '$.ranAs') > 1
    OR json_type("data", '$.ranAs') NOT IN ('array', 'null')
  ) ELSE 1 END)

records_session_not_ended_idx.name: records_session_not_ended_idx
records_session_not_ended_idx.where: kind = 'session' AND (CASE WHEN json_valid("records"."data") THEN coalesce(json_extract("records"."data", '$.state') NOT IN ('finished', 'crashed', 'paused', 'orphaned'), 1) ELSE 1 END)

records_session_wants_a_next_round_idx.name: records_session_wants_a_next_round_idx
records_session_wants_a_next_round_idx.where: kind = 'session' AND (CASE WHEN json_valid("records"."data") THEN json_extract("records"."data", '$.nextRound.state') = 'wanted' ELSE 1 END)

records_session_holds_worker_runs_idx.name: records_session_holds_worker_runs_idx
records_session_holds_worker_runs_idx.where: kind = 'session' AND (CASE WHEN json_valid("records"."data") THEN json_type("records"."data", '$.workerRuns') IS NOT NULL ELSE 1 END)

records_message_target_idx.name: records_message_target_idx
records_message_target_idx.where: kind = 'message' AND (CASE WHEN json_valid("records"."data") THEN json_type("records"."data", '$.target') END) IS NOT NULL

records_whose_move_idx.name: records_whose_move_idx
records_whose_move_idx.where: (CASE WHEN json_valid("records"."data") THEN json_extract("records"."data", '$.whose_move') END) IS NOT NULL

records_note_filed_under_the_grant_from_.name: records_note_filed_under_the_grant_from_idx
records_note_filed_under_the_grant_from_.where: kind = 'note' AND (CASE WHEN json_valid("records"."data") THEN json_extract("records"."data", '$.filed_under_the_grant.from') END) IS NOT NULL

registry_aliases_source.name: registry_aliases_source
registry_aliases_source.value: length("registry_aliases"."alias_id") > 0 AND "registry_aliases"."alias_id" = trim("registry_aliases"."alias_id") AND instr("registry_aliases"."alias_id", char(0)) = 0

registry_aliases_target.name: registry_aliases_target
registry_aliases_target.value: length("registry_aliases"."canonical_id") > 0 AND "registry_aliases"."canonical_id" = trim("registry_aliases"."canonical_id") AND instr("registry_aliases"."canonical_id", char(0)) = 0 AND "registry_aliases"."canonical_id" <> "registry_aliases"."alias_id"

revisions_first_upgrade_notice_idx.name: revisions_first_upgrade_notice_idx
revisions_first_upgrade_notice_idx.where: seq = 1 AND op = 'create' AND kind = 'message' AND json_extract(data, '$.notice') = 'stableUpgradeNotice'
